column3: A direct parallel: confronting assembled forces increases believers in faith and surrender.

Shows God repelling the attacking force and sparing believers from fighting.

Entrusts an affair to God under hostile dispute and divine awareness.
Describes believers who answer oppression with collective defense.
Links supporting God's cause with divine support and firm footing.
Forbids loss of heart and surrender while affirming divine presence.
Adds tranquility and near victory to believers' faithful commitment under pressure.

Contrasts allegiance to God with loyalty to opponents, ending in divine support.
